liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (1 review): The opening Bertha strikes the reviewer as low-energy [15]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Reviewer debates whether Jerry sings an odd line about a kicked eye and a blacked dog [8]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Second set closes with a jammy Truckin' [16]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): The Not Fade Away and Goin' Down the Road section is called incredible and smokin' [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-10-23.fm.cotsman.10359.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 159 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Somewhat muddy and hissy but easily listenable; pitch was corrected with Sound Forge [1]
- **gd1971-10-23.sbd.miller.111673.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 161 min; rated 3.64/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Typical Miller sound quality, apart from a brief FM patch during Bertha [8]
- **gd71-10-23.fmsbd.hanno.19862.sbeok.shnf**: FM broadcast; 24 songs; 157 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: The recording has distortion and speed problems [5]
- **gd71-10-23.fm.sbd.wizard.18666.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 151 min; rated 1/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Playback runs far too fast, possibly from the original taper's dragging machine [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer hears the intro as suggesting the band was bummed about Ramrod's bust [15]
- Jerry tells the crowd after the first set that everything is going to be alright [15]
- The broadcast also featured NRPS as another artist [2]
- Helps fill a gap in the 1971 collection; Pigpen is absent [8]
- Reviewer enjoys early Keith shows and shows with only Billy on drums [10]
- Another version of this show circulates with much better sound quality [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-10-23.fm.cotsman.10359.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Walter Schnell; transferred by Jeff Cotsman; source: SBD>FM>?>C>Sound Forge>SHN [1]. Also: Low-generation copy of a live FM broadcast, from tapes lent by Walter Schnell; part of the Music Never Stopped Project, 2002 [1]
- **gd1971-10-23.sbd.miller.111673.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 Inch - 1/2 Track) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> FLAC/24 [2]. Also: Source is the WABX FM broadcast, with seamless disc changes [2]
- **gd71-10-23.fmsbd.hanno.19862.sbeok.shnf**: source: FM [3]. Also: Spot check suggests this is a cassette taping of an FM broadcast [5]
- **gd71-10-23.fm.sbd.wizard.18666.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>FM>?>CASS>CD>EAC>DC5>CDThanks to the Wizard [4]. Also: Reviewer wonders whether it was recorded off the radio, and whether NRPS opened the show [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1971-10-23 GD NRPS Poster - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1971-10-23-gd-nrps-poster/) [18]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1971-10-24 Easttown Theatre, Detroit, MI - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1971-10-24-easttown-theatre-detroit-mi/) [19]
